svg.title: Book Tracker pages and navigation
svg.desc: Signed-in readers use the primary navigation for Currently Reading, Finished, and My site. My site links to Authors, Book metadata, and the reading profile. Catalog links open shared Work pages. Shared links and search results can enter the public profile directly. Authorized operators can open the restricted overview and catalog curation pages. The separate route access matrix lists readers and writes for every page.
